page_title: CEL 4-1 VAL | Celta Vigo v Valencia 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' This could get interesting! Pepelu (Valencia) is having to take over in goal after the injury to the keeper, as all the subs have been used.
90+6' Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+4' 4 - 1 Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
90+2' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
90+1' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) is able to continue to play.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
85' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
83' 3 - 1 GOAL! Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 3:1.
82' The attendance for today's match is 20457.
81' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) replacing Pablo Duran.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Javier Rodriguez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo).
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Diego Lopez (Valencia) coming on for Jose Copete.
79' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul after Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
74' Jose Copete (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
73' The offside statistics – 2:1.
71' Ricardo De Burgos sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
71' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Valencia players aren’t happy.
70' 2 - 1 Pepelu (Valencia) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
67' It will be a substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) is ready to enter the pitch as Borja Iglesias walks off.
67' Here is a change. Bryan Zaragoza is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
66' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Dimitri Foulquier and he is replaced by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia).
66' A substitution has been made. Javi Guerra is replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia).
65' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Julen Agirrezabala easily deals with the threat.
64' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
62' What was Largie Ramazani (Valencia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' 2 - 0 Goal! Pablo Duran feeds Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:0.
57' Today's match ends for Lucas Beltran who will be replaced by Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
57' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Luis Rioja (Valencia) replaces Thierry Correia.
53' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:11.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hugo Duro (Valencia) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Ionut Radu stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Andre Almeida (Valencia) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom right corner.
50' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Ionut Radu.
47' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
46' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
40' Andre Almeida (Valencia) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
38' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Ionut Radu leaps like a salmon to deny Lucas Beltran (Valencia), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
36' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Julen Agirrezabala.
32' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
31' One of the Valencia players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Celta Vigo.
28' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Williot Swedberg leaves the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
27' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

25' Williot Swedberg almost found himself in a promising position after Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
23' The fouls committed statistics – 2:3.
19' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
18' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.
18' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
18' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
16' The game is interrupted as Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is flagged offside.
15' Thierry Correia (Valencia) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
14' The total number of attempts is 2:4.
11' Javi Guerra (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and makes a call.
11' A dangerous towering header by Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
10' The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
9' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Julen Agirrezabala stops the ball from going inside right post.
9' Pepelu (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Pepelu (Valencia) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
7' Pepelu (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
6' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and signals a foul after Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) brought his opponent down. It's a penalty for Valencia!
5' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
3' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Ricardo De Burgos is the one to supervise the game today.
